knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

# Load Libraries

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(mice)
library(howManyImputations)
library(gtsummary)
library(survey)
library(mitools)
```

# Load Dataset
```{r}
df_stata <- haven::read_dta("gcq_hsls_subset.dta")
```

# Modify Dataset
```{r}
## Binary should be be 0/1 factor for logreg
df <- df_stata %>% mutate(
  first_gen = factor(first_gen, levels = c(0,1)),
  exp_ba = factor(exp_ba, levels = c(0,1))
) 

# Ordinal must be ordered factors
df$math_3level <- ordered(df$math_3level)
df$par_exp     <- ordered(df$par_exp)
df$pov_level <- ordered(df$pov_level)

# nominal must be factors
df$stud_race <- factor(df$stud_race)
df$par_race <- factor(df$par_race)
df$first_lang <- factor(df$first_lang)

df_subset <- df %>% dplyr::select(p1honors, par_exp, math_3level, par_race, par_sch_inv, first_gen, first_lang, frpl, math_score, public, urban, stud_race, starts_with("w1"), pov_level)
```

# Initial Run and Methods

```{r}
#Dry run: iterations = 0
init <- mice(df_subset, maxit = 0)
meth <- init$method
meth
```


```{r}
# Run chained equations imputation
df_imp <- mice(
  df_subset,
  m        = 5,     
  seed     = 123
)

# Save the imputed data
#save(df_imp, file = "df_imputed.rdata")

# Load imputed data
load("df_imputed.rdata")
```

## Racial/Ethnic Subgroups

### Write function
```{r}

run_hsls_glm <- function(data) {
  with(data, glm(
    p1honors ~ math_3level + 
      par_exp + par_race + par_sch_inv +
      first_gen + first_lang + frpl +
      math_score + public + urban,
    family = "binomial"))
}

```

## Asian American
```{r}
asian_imp <- filter(df_imp, stud_race == 1)
asian_glm <- with(asian_imp,   glm(
    p1honors ~ math_3level + 
      par_exp + par_sch_inv +
      first_gen + first_lang + frpl +
      math_score + public + urban,
    family = "binomial"
  ))
asian_glm %>% tbl_regression(exp = TRUE) %>% add_significance_stars(hide_se = FALSE, hide_p = TRUE) %>% add_glance_source_note() %>% as_flex_table()
```

## Black
```{r}
black_imp <- filter(df_imp, stud_race == 2)
```
